acceptanceResults.criterion: Build and packed-package smoke work from a clean directory
acceptanceResults.evidence: Isolated archive install and denied-checkout reads pass (AFM-011.package.test.ts). The full workspace clean build is now verified too: git clone into a fresh directory with no node_modules or dist, fresh BUN_INSTALL_CACHE_DIR, bun install --frozen-lockfile (1555 packages, bun.lock unchanged), then bun run build exit 0 producing 16 dist directories with no manual prebuild. Logs with checkout SHA, commands, exit codes and hashes: evidence/tickets/AFM-010/clean-install.log and clean-build.log. Packed-package operation is additionally proven by AFM-011.project-model-package.test.ts, which installs into an isolated consumer and performs a worker-backed commit under Node.

acceptanceResults.criterion: CLI, Studio and producer resolve the same owned diagram engine
acceptanceResults.evidence: Shared compileDiagram -> compileProject -> producer path; real Studio/CLI MP4 batch.
Exact directed edge identities checked in installed package tests and browser tracing.

findings.summary: The new Node export made project-model importable while its worker-backed commit was broken.
findings.detail: dist/storage.js resolved the worker with new URL('./worker.mjs', import.meta.url), i.e. dist/worker.mjs, which tsup does not emit. Copying the worker into dist would not help: it imports ./commit.ts, absent beside the bundle. Two further layers surfaced only once the first was fixed - the worker needs src/ and schemas/ shipped, and neither was in the package files list.
findings.consequence: Added a dual-layout resolver so the built entry points back at the shipped source worker (always spawned under Bun), and files now includes src and schemas. tests/acceptance/AFM-011.project-model-package.test.ts packs, installs and performs a real commit under Node - an import-only assertion passed throughout the broken period.

dependencyNote: AFM-011 depends on AFM-009 and AFM-010 only. An earlier session summary stated it depended on AFM-012; that is wrong and would invert AFM-012's own dependency on AFM-011. AFM-010 is now verified, so that blocker is cleared.
scopeNote: AFM-011's own criteria are met: clean-directory build and packed-package smoke, one owned engine resolved by CLI/Studio/producer, and authored topology surviving rendering. This does NOT claim the producer regression baseline - the four partitions are unrun and belong to AFM-012, which depends on AFM-011 and not the reverse.
supportBoundary: project-model exposes a Node-consumable entry whose worker-backed operations require Bun and Linux flock. It is not a Node-only, cross-platform storage package; that follows directly from the 'flock ... bun worker' invocation in commit.ts.
notPerformed: Installed-package coverage stops at initialize and reopen. A subsequent edit command, undo/redo and recovery through the installed exports are not yet exercised; that belongs with the persistence/package acceptance work.
